description.value: Waffle Magic is a specialty waffle shop in downtown Nanaimo focused entirely on fresh-made Brussels and Liege waffles — the former light and crisp, the latter soft and sweet. The menu spans sweet creations loaded with ice cream, fresh fruit, and housemade sauces as well as savory options like Brie with honey or rosemary ham with Havarti. A loyalty card rewards repeat visitors with every tenth waffle free.

bike_parking_detail: 1 rack within 100m: ground_slots (4 spaces) at 21m. Total: 4 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at wafflemagic.ca is live and confirms phone (250-753-9622), address (101 - 427 Fitzwilliam Street, Nanaimo, BC V9R 3A9), and menu. A gluten-free Brussels waffle option is explicitly noted on the menu ('Please add $2.00 for our gluten free Brussels waffle option'). No mention of bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or takeout availability appears on the site, so those remain null. OSM lists Tuesday as open but the website states Monday/Tuesday are both closed — flagged as a concern.
concerns: OSM opening_hours tag lists Tuesday as open (Tu-Sa), but the website explicitly states Monday and Tuesday are both closed. OSM tag should be updated.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active, independently operated waffle restaurant in central Nanaimo with a confirmed web presence and gluten-free option — a worthwhile food stop for touring cyclists passing through the city.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Website explicitly states 'Please add $2.00 for our gluten free Brussels waffle option.' Multiple menu items (fruit, sweet, and savoury waffles) contain no meat, though vegetarian labeling is not used
